name: Rockets.com
summary:
Welcome to ROCKets.com, where we dream big and ROCK hard!

...that's what the ROCKets.com website used to say before their space rocket Flying V crashed onto the company headquarters, killing everyone inside.

You're the inspector tasked with investigating what chain of events led to that terrible tragedy. Dig through the emails, put names to the faces, and find out exactly what went wrong.

The report is due on Friday. Good luck!
